sections.note: rc1c2c8, empty gradient zone before footer

proposed_rules.trigger: A full-bleed sibling node with no text and no [bg:*] tag, immediately followed by a narrower centered heading+paragraph node.
proposed_rules.decision: Treat identically to full-width-image-behind-text-is-section-bg: media becomes the section visual, overlaid heading+paragraph becomes default-content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same hero pattern implemented via /

proposed_rules.trigger: A heading + card row accompanied by explicit Previous/Next controls in the same text node (a slider/carousel of template cards).
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a dedicated carousel block (one row per template card) retaining prev/next as block-level UI, not as page content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternative: treat as a static repeating-cards grid (repeating-cards-are-one-block) — rejected because the explicit Previous/Next affordance signals a scrollable/paginated component whose behavior (not just layout) needs to survive migration.

proposed_rules.trigger: A [bg:gradient]/[bg:color] zone of substantial height (~500px) immediately before the footer, with no captured text.
proposed_rules.decision: Flag for Phase 2 targeted extraction — likely a CTA banner whose text failed to render/capture.
proposed_rules.rationale: Same empty gradient band recurs at the same page position across multiple templates; treating it as decoration-only risks dropping a real CTA.

notes: Tour/forms feature page: mixes a numbered-reasons grid, a templates showcase grid, and a Previous/Next templates carousel; ends with the same uncaptured pre-footer CTA band seen on other tour pages.
